say:6:1460601003:1.text: A party popper goes off, raining streamers on your head. The Mystical House is festooned with decorations. It looks like a party is underway.

say:6:1460601003:1.male: A party popper goes off, raining streamers on your head. The Mystical House is festooned with decorations. It looks like a party is underway.
say:6:1460601003:1.female: A party popper goes off, raining streamers on your head. The Mystical House is festooned with decorations. It looks like a party is underway.

say:7:1460601004:1.source_cn: 满满和漫漫簇拥着你，一人手上端着一杯形迹可疑的彩色液体。
say:7:1460601004:1.male: Chippy and Hammie crowd around you, each holding a glass of suspiciously colorful liquids.
say:7:1460601004:1.female: Chippy and Hammie crowd around you, each holding a glass of suspiciously colorful liquids.

say:8:1460601005:1.text: That's not right. Today isn't a festival!
say:8:1460601005:1.source_cn: 错了错了，不是这句，今天不是什么节日！
say:8:1460601005:1.male: That's not right. Today isn't a festival!
say:8:1460601005:1.female: That's not right. Today isn't a festival!

say:9:1460601006:1.text: Oh, right! In that case, welcome back, Magister!
say:9:1460601006:1.male: Oh, right! In that case, welcome back, Magister!
say:9:1460601006:1.female: Oh, right! In that case, welcome back, Magister!

say:10:1460601007:1.text: Miss Pandora is throwing a party! Wanna join, Merlin?
say:10:1460601007:1.source_cn: 潘多拉小姐组织了一场派对！梅林，你要加入吗？
say:10:1460601007:1.male: Miss Pandora is throwing a party! Wanna join, Merlin?
say:10:1460601007:1.female: Miss Pandora is throwing a party! Wanna join, Merlin?

say:11:1460601008:1.text: The theme is... Dolly's Cocktail Class!
say:11:1460601008:1.source_cn: 派对的主题就是——多莉的调酒小课堂！
say:11:1460601008:1.male: The theme is... Dolly's Cocktail Class!
say:11:1460601008:1.female: The theme is... Dolly's Cocktail Class!

choice_prompt:12:1460601008.text: The theme is... Dolly's Cocktail Class!
choice_prompt:12:1460601008.source_cn: 派对的主题就是——多莉的调酒小课堂！
choice_prompt:12:1460601008.male: The theme is... Dolly's Cocktail Class!
choice_prompt:12:1460601008.female: The theme is... Dolly's Cocktail Class!

say:13:1460601010:1.text: Dolly figured that since she was already teaching, she might as well teach a few more people. So we got invited too! Don't worry, all the drinks are alcohol-free.
say:13:1460601010:1.source_cn: 多莉说，都开小课堂了，索性多教几个人，所以我们也被邀请...
say:13:1460601010:1.male: Dolly figured that since she was already teaching, she might as well teach a few more people. So we got invited too! Don't worry, all the drinks are alcohol-free.
say:13:1460601010:1.female: Dolly figured that since she was already teaching, she might as well teach a few more people. So we got invited too! Don't worry, all the drinks are alcohol-free.

say:14:1460601011:1.text: She even bought a ton of party poppers and balloons. She's so nice!
say:14:1460601011:1.source_cn: 她还买了好多礼炮和气球给我们玩。真是个好人！
say:14:1460601011:1.male: She even bought a ton of party poppers and balloons. She's so nice!
say:14:1460601011:1.female: She even bought a ton of party poppers and balloons. She's so nice!

say:15:1460601012:1.text: You remember not long ago when Pandora suddenly showed up at the Mystical House from another world. You gave her a place to stay.
say:15:1460601012:1.source_cn: 你想起不久之前，来自异世界的潘多拉突然出现在神秘屋中，...
say:15:1460601012:1.male: You remember not long ago when Pandora suddenly showed up at the Mystical House from another world. You gave her a place to stay.
say:15:1460601012:1.female: You remember not long ago when Pandora suddenly showed up at the Mystical House from another world. You gave her a place to stay.

say:16:1460601013:1.text: She never strayed far from her foggy corner. Who would've thought she'd grown so close with everyone already?
say:16:1460601013:1.source_cn: 印象中你很少见到她离开那弥漫着雾气的一隅，没想到她竟然...
say:16:1460601013:1.male: She never strayed far from her foggy corner. Who would've thought she'd grown so close with everyone already?
say:16:1460601013:1.female: She never strayed far from her foggy corner. Who would've thought she'd grown so close with everyone already?

say:17:1460601014:3.text: Before you can even spot her, a drink with a lightly fragrant scent is placed in front of you.
say:17:1460601014:3.source_cn: 还没等你找到她的身影，一杯洋溢着淡淡香气的酒水就被端到...
say:17:1460601014:3.male: Before you can even spot her, a drink with a lightly fragrant scent is placed in front of you.
say:17:1460601014:3.female: Before you can even spot her, a drink with a lightly fragrant scent is placed in front of you.

say:20:1460601016:1.text: A small thank-you, for letting me stay.
say:20:1460601016:1.source_cn: 一份微不足道的回礼，向你表达我对你收留我的感谢。
say:20:1460601016:1.male: A small thank-you, for letting me stay.
say:20:1460601016:1.female: A small thank-you, for letting me stay.

say:21:1460601017:1.text: As Pandora offers you a drink, Dolly walks over, beaming with joy.
say:21:1460601017:1.source_cn: 在潘多拉献上酒水的间隙，多莉也带着满面的笑容迎了上来。
say:21:1460601017:1.male: As Pandora offers you a drink, Dolly walks over, beaming with joy.
say:21:1460601017:1.female: As Pandora offers you a drink, Dolly walks over, beaming with joy.

say:23:1460601018:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，你终于回来了！

say:24:1460601019:1.text: Guess what? Pandora's a natural. First time mixing drinks, and she already nailed the balance!
say:24:1460601019:1.source_cn: 我跟你说哦，潘多拉小姐好厉害，第一次上手就能把几种原料...
say:24:1460601019:1.male: Guess what? Pandora's a natural. First time mixing drinks, and she already nailed the balance!
say:24:1460601019:1.female: Guess what? Pandora's a natural. First time mixing drinks, and she already nailed the balance!

choice_prompt:25:1460601019.text: Guess what? Pandora's a natural. First time mixing drinks, and she already nailed the balance!
choice_prompt:25:1460601019.source_cn: 我跟你说哦，潘多拉小姐好厉害，第一次上手就能把几种原料的配比平衡得很好。
choice_prompt:25:1460601019.male: Guess what? Pandora's a natural. First time mixing drinks, and she already nailed the balance!
choice_prompt:25:1460601019.female: Guess what? Pandora's a natural. First time mixing drinks, and she already nailed the balance!

say:28:1460601021:1.text: Oh... maybe the ice melted while she was waiting for you.
say:28:1460601021:1.source_cn: 这样啊……可能是因为潘多拉小姐等你太久，冰有点化了。
say:28:1460601021:1.male: Oh... maybe the ice melted while she was waiting for you.
say:28:1460601021:1.female: Oh... maybe the ice melted while she was waiting for you.

say:29:1460601023:1.text: You flatter me. I still have a lot to learn.
say:29:1460601023:1.source_cn: 我的手艺还远远没到能被多莉小姐夸奖的程度呢。

say:30:1460601024:1.text: But for a beginner, you're doing great!
say:30:1460601024:1.source_cn: 作为初学者，已经相当出色了！
say:30:1460601024:1.male: But for a beginner, you're doing great!
say:30:1460601024:1.female: But for a beginner, you're doing great!

say:31:1460601025:1.source_cn: 相比之下，满满和漫漫做出来的就……

say:33:1460601026:1.text: Hey! Chippy's is actually pretty good! Just try it!
say:33:1460601026:1.source_cn: 满满做的可好了！不信你尝尝！

say:34:1460601027:1.text: I'll pass... If your drink doesn't knock me out for three days, I'll be surprised. Non-alcoholic doesn't mean non-dangerous!
say:34:1460601027:1.source_cn: 我才不要喝……你这杯喝完不晕个三天三夜，都不够我排毒的...

say:35:1460601028:1.text: That's only because your body is tiny. If you were big and strong like the Magister, you'd be fine!
say:35:1460601028:1.source_cn: 是因为你的身体太小了吧！如果身躯像主人一样健壮宏伟，一...

say:36:1460601029:1.text: Okay, okay, let's not get carried away. You two just learned what the ingredients are. It's totally normal if your drinks don't taste good yet.
say:36:1460601029:1.source_cn: 好啦好啦，你们才刚刚学完原料种类，做出来的饮料进不了口...

say:37:1460601030:1.text: You haven't even scratched the surface of mixing mocktails until you've learned the techniques.
say:37:1460601030:1.source_cn: 学了操作手法，你们才算真正入门了调酒。

say:38:1460601031:1.text: The chatter is lively and loud, but it's the kind of noise that feels like home.
say:38:1460601031:1.source_cn: 仓鼠们和多莉你一嘴我一嘴地聊着天，有些吵闹，却让人很安心。
say:38:1460601031:1.male: The chatter is lively and loud, but it's the kind of noise that feels like home.
say:38:1460601031:1.female: The chatter is lively and loud, but it's the kind of noise that feels like home.

say:40:1460601032:2.text: Though she's the one who organized the party, Pandora doesn't join the conversation. She simply stands quietly at your side.
say:40:1460601032:2.source_cn: 潘多拉作为派对的组织者，并没有加入，只是在你的身侧静静...
say:40:1460601032:2.male: Though she's the one who organized the party, Pandora doesn't join the conversation. She simply stands quietly at your side.
say:40:1460601032:2.female: Though she's the one who organized the party, Pandora doesn't join the conversation. She simply stands quietly at your side.

say:41:1460601033:1.text: Dolly looks really happy. That's nice to see.
say:41:1460601033:1.source_cn: 多莉小姐看上去很开心，真是太好了。
say:41:1460601033:1.male: Dolly looks really happy. That's nice to see.
say:41:1460601033:1.female: Dolly looks really happy. That's nice to see.

say:42:1460601034:1.text: She really loves feeling valued and needed, doesn't she?
say:42:1460601034:1.source_cn: 她非常喜欢被重视、被需要的感觉，对不对？
say:42:1460601034:1.male: She really loves feeling valued and needed, doesn't she?
say:42:1460601034:1.female: She really loves feeling valued and needed, doesn't she?

say:43:1460601035:1.text: A thought crosses your mind: this stranger from another world has lost both her home and her friends. You can't help but wonder how she's feeling right now.
say:43:1460601035:1.source_cn: 你突然想起这位异乡的来客失去了家乡，也失去了所有的朋友...
say:43:1460601035:1.male: A thought crosses your mind: this stranger from another world has lost both her home and her friends. You can't help but wonder how she's feeling right now.
say:43:1460601035:1.female: A thought crosses your mind: this stranger from another world has lost both her home and her friends. You can't help but wonder how she's feeling right now.

say:44:1460601036:1.text: You try to read the feelings in her eyes, but all that you see is a glimmer of light beneath the strands of her lowered hair.
say:44:1460601036:1.source_cn: 当你想仔细看看她的眼眸中蕴藏着什么情绪时，却只能看到垂...
say:44:1460601036:1.male: You try to read the feelings in her eyes, but all that you see is a glimmer of light beneath the strands of her lowered hair.
say:44:1460601036:1.female: You try to read the feelings in her eyes, but all that you see is a glimmer of light beneath the strands of her lowered hair.

say:45:1460601037:0.text: Can... I call you Merlin too? Like they do?
say:45:1460601037:0.source_cn: 我可以像她们一样，叫你梅林吗？你……
say:45:1460601037:0.male: Can... I call you Merlin too? Like they do?
say:45:1460601037:0.female: Can... I call you Merlin too? Like they do?

say:46:1460601038:2.text: What are you and Miss Pandora whispering about?
say:46:1460601038:2.source_cn: 啊，梅林！你在和潘多拉小姐说什么悄悄话呢？
say:46:1460601038:2.male: What are you and Miss Pandora whispering about?
say:46:1460601038:2.female: What are you and Miss Pandora whispering about?

say:47:1460601039:2.text: Dolly is teaching us how to mix drinks. Come join us?
say:47:1460601039:2.source_cn: 多莉要教我们调酒的手法，你要加入吗？
say:47:1460601039:2.male: Dolly is teaching us how to mix drinks. Come join us?
say:47:1460601039:2.female: Dolly is teaching us how to mix drinks. Come join us?

say:48:1460601040:1.text: You're learning to mix drinks too, Magister? I've never tasted anything you've made!
say:48:1460601040:1.source_cn: 梅林大人也要学调酒吗……我还没喝过你做的饮料呢！
say:48:1460601040:1.male: You're learning to mix drinks too, Magister? I've never tasted anything you've made!
say:48:1460601040:1.female: You're learning to mix drinks too, Magister? I've never tasted anything you've made!

say:49:1460601041:1.text: I can't even imagine how it'll taste. I'm so curious now!
say:49:1460601041:1.source_cn: 真是想象不出会是什么味道，好期待啊！
say:49:1460601041:1.male: I can't even imagine how it'll taste. I'm so curious now!
say:49:1460601041:1.female: I can't even imagine how it'll taste. I'm so curious now!

say:50:1460601042:1.text: And so, with everyone cheering you on, you join Dolly's mocktail class.
say:50:1460601042:1.source_cn: 于是，在几人的盛情邀请下，你也加入了多莉的调酒小课堂。
say:50:1460601042:1.male: And so, with everyone cheering you on, you join Dolly's mocktail class.
say:50:1460601042:1.female: And so, with everyone cheering you on, you join Dolly's mocktail class.

say:52:1460601022:1.text: Right? Pandora might have a real gift for this!
say:52:1460601022:1.source_cn: 对吧？潘多拉小姐好像特别有调酒的天赋呢。
say:52:1460601022:1.male: Right? Pandora might have a real gift for this!
say:52:1460601022:1.female: Right? Pandora might have a real gift for this!

say:53:1460601009:1.text: Pandora paid for everything herself. Must've cost a fortune.
say:53:1460601009:1.source_cn: 潘多拉小姐自掏腰包买的哦，花了不少钱呢。
say:53:1460601009:1.male: Pandora paid for everything herself. Must've cost a fortune.
say:53:1460601009:1.female: Pandora paid for everything herself. Must've cost a fortune.

narration:0:1460602001:0.source_cn: 多莉开始将自己的独家手法传授给小课堂的听众们。

say:12:1460602004:1.source_cn: 最后，倒进杯子里，加入果汁搅拌一下~

choice_prompt:14:1460602004.text: Now pour it into a glass, add some juice, give it a stir...
choice_prompt:14:1460602004.source_cn: 最后，倒进杯子里，加入果汁搅拌一下~

say:16:1460602006:1.text: Following Dolly's demonstration, you manage to make a drink that looks pretty decent.
say:16:1460602006:1.source_cn: 你在多莉的示范下，做出了一杯看上去不错的饮品。

say:17:1460602007:1.text: Wow... The Magister's first drink, made right here in my tavern!
say:17:1460602007:1.source_cn: 哇……这就是大魔法师在我的月桂酒馆亲手调制的第一杯饮料！

say:18:1460602008:1.text: It's too bad we don't have a crowd. I bet people would line up to witness this moment.
say:18:1460602008:1.source_cn: 可惜现在只有咱们几个人，不然感觉会吸引很多人来观瞻呢。

say:19:1460602009:1.text: Actually, maybe it's better this way. If we had a crowd, we'd probably end up wrestling over it.
say:19:1460602009:1.source_cn: 幸亏只有咱们几个人，不然肯定会有很多人来抢着喝。

say:20:1460602010:1.text: Oh, Magister, I want to try it too!
say:20:1460602010:1.source_cn: 对哦！主人，我也想尝尝你这杯！
say:20:1460602010:1.male: Oh, Magister, I want to try it too!
say:20:1460602010:1.female: Oh, Magister, I want to try it too!

say:22:1460602011:1.text: Wait your turn, little guy. Let's see what Dolly thinks of it first.
say:22:1460602011:1.source_cn: 等等吧，小仓鼠，先让多莉检察一下水平如何？

say:23:1460602012:1.text: You pass the drink to Dolly first to get her expert opinion.
say:23:1460602012:1.source_cn: 潘多拉或许注意到了你手中的不是无酒精饮料，你顺着她的话...
say:23:1460602012:1.male: You pass the drink to Dolly first to get her expert opinion.
say:23:1460602012:1.female: You pass the drink to Dolly first to get her expert opinion.

say:24:1460602013:1.text: For me? I'll gladly take it!
say:24:1460602013:1.source_cn: 给我吗？那我可不客气了哦！
say:24:1460602013:1.male: For me? I'll gladly take it!
say:24:1460602013:1.female: For me? I'll gladly take it!

say:27:1460602015:1.text: ... This is really good! I mean it. Magister, you're good at everything, aren't you?
say:27:1460602015:1.source_cn: ……很好喝！不愧是梅林大人，真是做什么都像模像样的。
say:27:1460602015:1.male: ... This is really good! I mean it. Magister, you're good at everything, aren't you?
say:27:1460602015:1.female: ... This is really good! I mean it. Magister, you're good at everything, aren't you?

say:28:1460602016:1.text: It's got a mature, steady taste with a rich finish... kind of like you, don't you think, Magister?
say:28:1460602016:1.source_cn: 这杯酒水的风味成熟又可靠，有丰富的回味，很像梅林大人给...
say:28:1460602016:1.male: It's got a mature, steady taste with a rich finish... kind of like you, don't you think, Magister?
say:28:1460602016:1.female: It's got a mature, steady taste with a rich finish... kind of like you, don't you think, Magister?

say:29:1460602017:1.text: If I had to nitpick, it could've used a bit more juice. But to be honest, that kind of imperfection suits you, too...
say:29:1460602017:1.source_cn: 如果说有什么美中不足的地方，就是果汁给的有点少。这种会...
say:29:1460602017:1.male: If I had to nitpick, it could've used a bit more juice. But to be honest, that kind of imperfection suits you, too...
say:29:1460602017:1.female: If I had to nitpick, it could've used a bit more juice. But to be honest, that kind of imperfection suits you, too...

say:31:1460602018:1.text: Dolly! Try Chippy's next. I want to know what kind of vibe my drink gives off!
say:31:1460602018:1.source_cn: 啊！多莉！也尝尝我的，告诉我我给人的感觉是怎样的！

say:35:1460602020:1.text: While the others are caught up in a lively commotion over Dolly's mocktail critiques, Pandora quietly focuses on the drink in her hands.
say:35:1460602020:1.source_cn: 几人因为多莉的调酒点评闹成一团，而一旁的潘多拉正认真地...
say:35:1460602020:1.male: While the others are caught up in a lively commotion over Dolly's mocktail critiques, Pandora quietly focuses on the drink in her hands.
say:35:1460602020:1.female: While the others are caught up in a lively commotion over Dolly's mocktail critiques, Pandora quietly focuses on the drink in her hands.

say:39:1460602021:1.text: It looks like she's doing something more complex than what Dolly showed. She's been at it for a while now.
say:39:1460602021:1.source_cn: 她的这杯工序好像比多莉教学的更复杂，你见她又忙活了好一会儿。
say:39:1460602021:1.male: It looks like she's doing something more complex than what Dolly showed. She's been at it for a while now.
say:39:1460602021:1.female: It looks like she's doing something more complex than what Dolly showed. She's been at it for a while now.

say:42:1460602023:1.text: Thank you. I'm not sure if my homeland's flavors will suit your taste.
say:42:1460602023:1.source_cn: 过奖了，不知道我家乡的做法合不合你们的口味。

say:45:1460602025:1.text: This drink is made the way we do it back home. It might taste a little different from what you're used to in Esperia.
say:45:1460602025:1.source_cn: 这是用我家乡的做法调制的酒水，和伊索米亚常见的风味或许...

say:46:1460602026:1.text: Still, the ingredients are all Esperian delicacies Dolly introduced, so I guess this drink carries a bit of both our worlds.
say:46:1460602026:1.source_cn: 原料都是多莉小姐介绍的伊索米亚珍馐，所以这杯酒融合了两...

say:47:1460602027:1.text: I want you to try it, Dolly.
say:47:1460602027:1.source_cn: 我想让你尝尝，多莉小姐。

say:48:1460602028:1.text: This is... I've never tasted anything like it.
say:48:1460602028:1.source_cn: ……这真是……我完全没有想过的风味！

say:49:1460602029:1.text: I think I can guess which ingredients you treated differently, but what exactly did you do?
say:49:1460602029:1.source_cn: 我好像知道你对哪几种材料做了特殊的处理，但具体是什么处理呢？

say:50:1460602030:1.text: Would you mind telling me? I feel like I've just gotten a bunch of new ideas!
say:50:1460602030:1.source_cn: 潘多拉小姐，可以告诉我吗？我感觉又有了很多新的灵感。

say:51:1460602031:1.text: Sure! I'm just glad you want to learn about it.
say:51:1460602031:1.source_cn: 当然可以……你愿意了解，我再开心不过了。

say:52:1460602032:1.text: And if you don't mind, I'd love your help. I want to make something that everyone can enjoy.
say:52:1460602032:1.source_cn: 而且，我希望你能指导我改进，让大家都能尝到完美平衡的味道。

say:54:1460602034:1.text: Pandora looks at you, waiting to see how you'll react to the drink.
say:54:1460602034:1.source_cn: 潘多拉的眼睛看向了你，她期待着你喝到这杯酒水后的反应。
say:54:1460602034:1.male: Pandora looks at you, waiting to see how you'll react to the drink.
say:54:1460602034:1.female: Pandora looks at you, waiting to see how you'll react to the drink.

say:55:1460602035:1.text: Dolly clearly notices too. A look of realization flashes across her face.
say:55:1460602035:1.source_cn: 多莉显然也注意到了，她突然露出恍然大悟的神情。
say:55:1460602035:1.male: Dolly clearly notices too. A look of realization flashes across her face.
say:55:1460602035:1.female: Dolly clearly notices too. A look of realization flashes across her face.

say:56:1460602036:1.text: So this is the gift Pandora decided on in the end! What a great idea.
say:56:1460602036:1.source_cn: 原来潘多拉小姐最后决定的回礼是这个啊！真是个不错的主意。
say:56:1460602036:1.male: So this is the gift Pandora decided on in the end! What a great idea.
say:56:1460602036:1.female: So this is the gift Pandora decided on in the end! What a great idea.

choice_prompt:57:1460602036.text: So this is the gift Pandora decided on in the end! What a great idea.
choice_prompt:57:1460602036.source_cn: 原来潘多拉小姐最后决定的回礼是这个啊！真是个不错的主意。
choice_prompt:57:1460602036.male: So this is the gift Pandora decided on in the end! What a great idea.
choice_prompt:57:1460602036.female: So this is the gift Pandora decided on in the end! What a great idea.

say:58:1460602037:1.text: Better to hear it from Pandora herself.
say:58:1460602037:1.source_cn: 还是让潘多拉小姐亲口告诉你吧。
say:58:1460602037:1.male: Better to hear it from Pandora herself.
say:58:1460602037:1.female: Better to hear it from Pandora herself.

choice_prompt:59:1460602037.text: Better to hear it from Pandora herself.
choice_prompt:59:1460602037.source_cn: 还是让潘多拉小姐亲口告诉你吧。
choice_prompt:59:1460602037.male: Better to hear it from Pandora herself.
choice_prompt:59:1460602037.female: Better to hear it from Pandora herself.

say:60:1460602038:1.text: Let me mix the perfect drink first.
say:60:1460602038:1.source_cn: 还是让我先把最完美的一杯调出来吧。
say:60:1460602038:1.male: Let me mix the perfect drink first.
say:60:1460602038:1.female: Let me mix the perfect drink first.

narration:61:1460602039:1.text: Pandora and Dolly launch into a spirited debate about mixing techniques. In no time, one tasty drink after another starts pouring out.

narration:62:1460602040:1.text: The drinks keep flowing, and even the familiars are excited from all the excitement...

narration:0:1460603001:0.text: The familiars are fast asleep, and Dolly's cheeks are flushed. Looks like the party is winding down.
narration:0:1460603001:0.source_cn: 仓鼠们已经沉沉睡去，多莉也面色酡红，看来快乐的派对要迎...

say:3:1460603002:1.text: Chippy... Hammie! Come on, don't fall asleep on the bar...
say:3:1460603002:1.source_cn: 满满……漫漫！醒醒呀，别睡在吧台上……

say:4:1460603003:1.text: No good. I'll have to carry them to their room...
say:4:1460603003:1.source_cn: 不行，我得把他们搬到到房间里……

choice_prompt:5:1460603003.text: No good. I'll have to carry them to their room...
choice_prompt:5:1460603003.source_cn: 不行，我得把他们搬到到房间里……

say:6:1460603004:1.text: Alright... hic... Pandora, don't forget your gift.
say:6:1460603004:1.source_cn: 好吧，我……嗝！潘多拉小姐，别忘了你的回礼哦。

say:7:1460603005:1.text: I'll clean up the hall first. No, wait, I need to take Chippy and Hammie to their room... no, maybe I should grab some blankets first...
say:7:1460603005:1.source_cn: 我先收拾大厅，不对，我先送满满漫漫去房间……不对，我先...

say:8:1460603006:1.text: Compared to Dolly's flustered scramble, Pandora looks just as calm as ever.
say:8:1460603006:1.source_cn: 和多莉的狼狈相比，潘多拉倒是看上去和平常没什么区别。
say:8:1460603006:1.male: Compared to Dolly's flustered scramble, Pandora looks just as calm as ever.
say:8:1460603006:1.female: Compared to Dolly's flustered scramble, Pandora looks just as calm as ever.

say:9:1460603007:1.text: Dolly, go ahead and take them upstairs. I can tidy up here with magic.
say:9:1460603007:1.source_cn: 多莉小姐，你送仓鼠回房间吧，我可以帮忙用魔法清理这边。

say:10:1460603008:1.text: That'd be a big help! You really are the best!
say:10:1460603008:1.source_cn: 那就麻烦你了！潘多拉小姐，你真是个好人……

say:12:1460603009:1.text: With one in each arm, Dolly hauls Chippy and Hammie away. Meanwhile, Pandora flicks her fingers, and the cups all float into the sink.
say:12:1460603009:1.source_cn: 多莉一边一个，抱走了满满和漫漫。这边潘多拉轻轻动手，杯...
say:12:1460603009:1.male: With one in each arm, Dolly hauls Chippy and Hammie away. Meanwhile, Pandora flicks her fingers, and the cups all float into the sink.
say:12:1460603009:1.female: With one in each arm, Dolly hauls Chippy and Hammie away. Meanwhile, Pandora flicks her fingers, and the cups all float into the sink.

say:13:1460603010:0.text: This kind of spell must be easy for you. But it's usually Dolly who handles things like this.
say:13:1460603010:0.source_cn: 这种程度的魔法，你应该很容易就能做到吧？不过，平常还是...
say:13:1460603010:0.male: This kind of spell must be easy for you. But it's usually Dolly who handles things like this.
say:13:1460603010:0.female: This kind of spell must be easy for you. But it's usually Dolly who handles things like this.

say:14:1460603011:0.text: She's the one who's looked after me ever since I got here, when I didn't know a thing about this place.
say:14:1460603011:0.source_cn: 也是她一直照顾着初来乍到，什么都不懂的我。
say:14:1460603011:0.male: She's the one who's looked after me ever since I got here, when I didn't know a thing about this place.
say:14:1460603011:0.female: She's the one who's looked after me ever since I got here, when I didn't know a thing about this place.

choice_prompt:15:1460603011.text: She's the one who's looked after me ever since I got here, when I didn't know a thing about this place.
choice_prompt:15:1460603011.source_cn: 也是她一直照顾着初来乍到，什么都不懂的我。
choice_prompt:15:1460603011.male: She's the one who's looked after me ever since I got here, when I didn't know a thing about this place.
choice_prompt:15:1460603011.female: She's the one who's looked after me ever since I got here, when I didn't know a thing about this place.

say:16:1460603012:0.text: She really is. I've never met anyone so quick to help those in need.
say:16:1460603012:0.source_cn: 是啊。她是我见过的最不吝惜帮助别人的人。
say:16:1460603012:0.male: She really is. I've never met anyone so quick to help those in need.
say:16:1460603012:0.female: She really is. I've never met anyone so quick to help those in need.

say:17:1460603013:0.text: If she goes too long without helping someone, she actually gets a little down...
say:17:1460603013:0.source_cn: 如果没有机会帮上别人的忙，她甚至会觉得失落……
say:17:1460603013:0.male: If she goes too long without helping someone, she actually gets a little down...
say:17:1460603013:0.female: If she goes too long without helping someone, she actually gets a little down...

say:18:1460603014:1.text: Magister, don't ever let her feel like she's not needed.
say:18:1460603014:1.source_cn: 大魔法师，可别让她总觉得自己帮不上忙哦。
say:18:1460603014:1.male: Magister, don't ever let her feel like she's not needed.
say:18:1460603014:1.female: Magister, don't ever let her feel like she's not needed.

choice_prompt:19:1460603014.text: Magister, don't ever let her feel like she's not needed.
choice_prompt:19:1460603014.source_cn: 大魔法师，可别让她总觉得自己帮不上忙哦。
choice_prompt:19:1460603014.male: Magister, don't ever let her feel like she's not needed.
choice_prompt:19:1460603014.female: Magister, don't ever let her feel like she's not needed.

say:20:1460603015:1.text: As expected... she never told you.
say:20:1460603015:1.source_cn: 嗯……她果然没有和你说过啊。
say:20:1460603015:1.male: As expected... she never told you.
say:20:1460603015:1.female: As expected... she never told you.

say:21:1460603016:1.text: While you were out there saving Esperia, Dolly could only stay behind and hold down the fort. She did her best to take care of you in whatever ways she could.
say:21:1460603016:1.source_cn: 在你拯救伊索米亚的时候，多莉只能帮你看家，尽量照顾好你...
say:21:1460603016:1.male: While you were out there saving Esperia, Dolly could only stay behind and hold down the fort. She did her best to take care of you in whatever ways she could.
say:21:1460603016:1.female: While you were out there saving Esperia, Dolly could only stay behind and hold down the fort. She did her best to take care of you in whatever ways she could.

say:22:1460603017:1.text: Even then, you still ran into danger again and again. You'd come back to the Mystical House all beaten up and needing a long time to recover.
say:22:1460603017:1.source_cn: 但你还是经常遭遇这样那样的危险，带着一身伤痛回到神秘屋...
say:22:1460603017:1.male: Even then, you still ran into danger again and again. You'd come back to the Mystical House all beaten up and needing a long time to recover.
say:22:1460603017:1.female: Even then, you still ran into danger again and again. You'd come back to the Mystical House all beaten up and needing a long time to recover.

say:23:1460603018:1.text: When she talked about it, she looked so guilty. She thought she hadn't taken care of you properly. That she couldn't do anything to help.
say:23:1460603018:1.source_cn: 多莉说起这件事的时候，看上去非常内疚，她觉得自己没有照...
say:23:1460603018:1.male: When she talked about it, she looked so guilty. She thought she hadn't taken care of you properly. That she couldn't do anything to help.
say:23:1460603018:1.female: When she talked about it, she looked so guilty. She thought she hadn't taken care of you properly. That she couldn't do anything to help.

say:24:1460603019:0.text: I doubt you see it that way. But... she doesn't know that.
say:24:1460603019:0.source_cn: 我觉得，你一定是不会这么想的，她只是，不知道……
say:24:1460603019:0.male: I doubt you see it that way. But... she doesn't know that.
say:24:1460603019:0.female: I doubt you see it that way. But... she doesn't know that.

say:27:1460603020:0.source_cn: 我也不知道梅林大人在想什么……

say:28:1460603021:0.text: Sorry. I don't think I can help you with that, Pandora...
say:28:1460603021:0.source_cn: 抱歉，就算潘多拉小姐问我，我也……

say:29:1460603022:1.text: I have no idea what kind of gift Magister Merlin would want.
say:29:1460603022:1.source_cn: 我其实也想不出来梅林大人会希望收到怎样的礼物。

say:30:1460603023:1.text: Is it because he doesn't like feeling indebted to anyone? I've met people like that too...
say:30:1460603023:1.source_cn: 是因为不喜欢欠人情吗？我确实也见过这样的类型……

say:31:1460603024:1.text: I don't think that's it either. He accepts any gift, but he just never really shows any preference for anything.
say:31:1460603024:1.source_cn: 应该也不是，送给梅林大人什么都会被收下，但梅林大人不会...

say:32:1460603025:1.text: Although, I did hear the Magister used to collect rare treasures. I'd suggest something unusual or hard to find as a gift.
say:32:1460603025:1.source_cn: 不过我听说梅林大人在过去确实有收藏一些珍宝，或许他会喜...

say:33:1460603026:1.text: I'll get in touch with Rowan and ask him to bring something along when he delivers the balloons!
say:33:1460603026:1.source_cn: 我去联系罗万，让他送气球的时候捎上一些！

say:35:1460603027:3.text: Not long after, Dolly and Rowan return, still chatting as they walk over.
say:35:1460603027:3.source_cn: 不多时，多莉和罗万一边交谈一边走了过来。

say:36:1460603028:1.text: You should've told me sooner! I could've found something better for the occasion.
say:36:1460603028:1.source_cn: 太突然啦！要是你早点说，我还能去给你们找点儿更好的东西。

say:37:1460603029:1.text: You always bring the best stuff, Rowan. Good quality, fair price!
say:37:1460603029:1.source_cn: 罗万每次带过来的东西都很好啊，质优价廉！

say:38:1460603030:1.text: Still, shopping for yourself isn't quite the same as picking out a gift for someone.
say:38:1460603030:1.source_cn: 话虽如此，但是平常买的东西，和要送人的礼物，感觉还是不...

say:39:1460603031:1.text: Ah, Miss Pandora! Your balloons are by the door!
say:39:1460603031:1.source_cn: 啊，潘多拉小姐！你订的气球我放在门口了！

say:40:1460603032:1.text: And here's that extra item... that weird little thing you asked for!
say:40:1460603032:1.source_cn: 还有临时追加的这个……稀奇古怪的小玩意！

say:42:1460603034:1.text: It's a seashell, found only near Rustport. That area just reopened, so shipments are finally starting again.
say:42:1460603034:1.source_cn: 锈锚港附近特有的海螺，最近那边解除了封锁，航线正在慢慢恢复。

say:43:1460603035:1.text: This kind of seashell is slightly poisonous, so there aren't many around. For people outside the region, it's something pretty rare.
say:43:1460603035:1.source_cn: 这海螺有毒，所以产量很少，对其他地方的人来说，可绝对算...

say:44:1460603036:1.text: It's beautiful... That blue color and shine, it almost looks like a siren's feather.
say:44:1460603036:1.source_cn: 好美……！这蓝色和光泽，简直就像塞壬的羽毛一样。

say:47:1460603039:1.text: Must be something from Pandora's world!
say:47:1460603039:1.source_cn: 应该是潘多拉小姐家乡的什么东西吧！

say:48:1460603040:1.text: I think the seashell's really pretty. It feels like something Magister Merlin would want to keep.
say:48:1460603040:1.source_cn: 潘多拉小姐，我觉得这个海螺很好看哦，像是梅林大人会想要...

say:49:1460603041:1.text: Wait, this is for the Magister? That might be a bit awkward.
say:49:1460603041:1.source_cn: 啊……原来你们是要送给梅林啊？那可能有点麻烦。

say:50:1460603042:1.text: I mean, he's the reason Rustport reopened in the first place...
say:50:1460603042:1.source_cn: 毕竟促成锈锚港重新通航的就是梅林嘛……

say:51:1460603043:1.source_cn: 没、没关系的，潘多拉小姐！

say:52:1460603044:1.text: I'm sure even the Magister wouldn't just pick up something poisonous off the ground...
say:52:1460603044:1.source_cn: 就算是梅林大人，应该也不会随便捡有毒的海产吧……？

say:53:1460603045:1.text: ... Thank you, Rowan. I really like it. How much is it?
say:53:1460603045:1.source_cn: ……谢谢你，商人先生。这个我很喜欢，多少钱？

say:1:1460604001:1.text: Rowan named a high price. Dolly glanced at me, clearly worried I wouldn't have that kind of cash.
say:1:1460604001:1.source_cn: 罗万说出了一个高价，多莉立即为难地看着我——她觉得我的...
say:1:1460604001:1.male: Rowan named a high price. Dolly glanced at me, clearly worried I wouldn't have that kind of cash.
say:1:1460604001:1.female: Rowan named a high price. Dolly glanced at me, clearly worried I wouldn't have that kind of cash.

say:2:1460604002:1.text: She wasn't wrong. I don't have much Esperia currency. So I asked Rowan if he'd take coins from my homeland instead.
say:2:1460604002:1.source_cn: 我确实没有这么多伊索米亚的货币，所以我问罗万，用我家乡...
say:2:1460604002:1.male: She wasn't wrong. I don't have much Esperia currency. So I asked Rowan if he'd take coins from my homeland instead.
say:2:1460604002:1.female: She wasn't wrong. I don't have much Esperia currency. So I asked Rowan if he'd take coins from my homeland instead.

say:3:1460604003:1.text: He ended up only taking one. He's so kind. Everyone I've met here has been so kind.
say:3:1460604003:1.source_cn: 结果他只拿了一枚，真是太善良了。我来到这里之后，遇到的...
say:3:1460604003:1.male: He ended up only taking one. He's so kind. Everyone I've met here has been so kind.
say:3:1460604003:1.female: He ended up only taking one. He's so kind. Everyone I've met here has been so kind.

choice_prompt:4:1460604003.text: He ended up only taking one. He's so kind. Everyone I've met here has been so kind.
choice_prompt:4:1460604003.source_cn: 结果他只拿了一枚，真是太善良了。我来到这里之后，遇到的都是好人呢。
choice_prompt:4:1460604003.male: He ended up only taking one. He's so kind. Everyone I've met here has been so kind.
choice_prompt:4:1460604003.female: He ended up only taking one. He's so kind. Everyone I've met here has been so kind.

say:5:1460604004:1.text: It'd be great if some collector happened to be interested in coins from another world.
say:5:1460604004:1.source_cn: 如果能有收藏家对异世界的金币感兴趣就好了。
say:5:1460604004:1.male: It'd be great if some collector happened to be interested in coins from another world.
say:5:1460604004:1.female: It'd be great if some collector happened to be interested in coins from another world.

say:6:1460604006:1.source_cn: 总之，之前的事情就是这样了。

say:7:1460604007:1.text: The original gift I had in mind probably wasn't right for you.
say:7:1460604007:1.source_cn: 原本为大魔法师挑选的礼物，恐怕不会太合你的心意呢。
say:7:1460604007:1.male: The original gift I had in mind probably wasn't right for you.
say:7:1460604007:1.female: The original gift I had in mind probably wasn't right for you.

say:8:1460604008:1.text: Then Rowan reminded me that you might appreciate something unfamiliar. Something you've never seen before.
say:8:1460604008:1.source_cn: 但罗万提醒了我，或许你会喜欢自己从没见过、体验过的事物。
say:8:1460604008:1.male: Then Rowan reminded me that you might appreciate something unfamiliar. Something you've never seen before.
say:8:1460604008:1.female: Then Rowan reminded me that you might appreciate something unfamiliar. Something you've never seen before.

say:9:1460604009:1.text: So this party is both a way to thank Dolly and a chance to properly express my gratitude to you.
say:9:1460604009:1.source_cn: 所以，这场派对既是为了对多莉回礼，也是为了向你正式表达...
say:9:1460604009:1.male: So this party is both a way to thank Dolly and a chance to properly express my gratitude to you.
say:9:1460604009:1.female: So this party is both a way to thank Dolly and a chance to properly express my gratitude to you.

say:10:1460604010:1.text: Magister Merlin, savior of Esperia, please accept this drink from someone far from home.
say:10:1460604010:1.source_cn: 大魔法师梅林，伊索米亚的拯救者，请收下这杯异乡人献上的酒。
say:10:1460604010:1.male: Magister Merlin, savior of Esperia, please accept this drink from someone far from home.
say:10:1460604010:1.female: Magister Merlin, savior of Esperia, please accept this drink from someone far from home.

choice_prompt:11:1460604010.text: Magister Merlin, savior of Esperia, please accept this drink from someone far from home.
choice_prompt:11:1460604010.source_cn: 大魔法师梅林，伊索米亚的拯救者，请收下这杯异乡人献上的酒。
choice_prompt:11:1460604010.male: Magister Merlin, savior of Esperia, please accept this drink from someone far from home.
choice_prompt:11:1460604010.female: Magister Merlin, savior of Esperia, please accept this drink from someone far from home.

narration:12:1460604011:0.text: The chilled blue liquid rolls across your tongue, carrying traces of salt from the rim and leaving behind a scent that feels strangely unfamiliar.
narration:12:1460604011:0.source_cn: 冰凉的蓝色液体裹挟着杯口的盐粒，从你的舌尖翻卷而过，留...
narration:12:1460604011:0.male: The chilled blue liquid rolls across your tongue, carrying traces of salt from the rim and leaving behind a scent that feels strangely unfamiliar.
narration:12:1460604011:0.female: The chilled blue liquid rolls across your tongue, carrying traces of salt from the rim and leaving behind a scent that feels strangely unfamiliar.

narration:13:1460604012:0.text: Even though you're not a Windwhisperer, at that moment, you can feel a breeze drifting from the shore of another world.
narration:13:1460604012:0.source_cn: 并非风语者的你，也在这时，嗅到了从另一个世界的海边刮来的风
narration:13:1460604012:0.male: Even though you're not a Windwhisperer, at that moment, you can feel a breeze drifting from the shore of another world.
narration:13:1460604012:0.female: Even though you're not a Windwhisperer, at that moment, you can feel a breeze drifting from the shore of another world.

narration:14:1460604013:1.text: You close your eyes to savor it. And just then, Pandora quietly lets out a breath.
narration:14:1460604013:1.source_cn: 你闭上了眼，细细地品味着。趁着这短暂的功夫，潘多拉悄悄...
narration:14:1460604013:1.male: You close your eyes to savor it. And just then, Pandora quietly lets out a breath.
narration:14:1460604013:1.female: You close your eyes to savor it. And just then, Pandora quietly lets out a breath.

say:15:1460604014:1.text: I'm glad... It seems like you're enjoying it.
say:15:1460604014:1.male: I'm glad... It seems like you're enjoying it.
say:15:1460604014:1.female: I'm glad... It seems like you're enjoying it.

say:16:1460604015:1.text: Still, one drink doesn't feel like enough to repay your kindness. Is there anything else I can do for you?
say:16:1460604015:1.source_cn: 光是一杯酒的价值好像还不足以回报你的恩情，还有什么我能...
say:16:1460604015:1.male: Still, one drink doesn't feel like enough to repay your kindness. Is there anything else I can do for you?
say:16:1460604015:1.female: Still, one drink doesn't feel like enough to repay your kindness. Is there anything else I can do for you?

choice_prompt:17:1460604015.text: Still, one drink doesn't feel like enough to repay your kindness. Is there anything else I can do for you?
choice_prompt:17:1460604015.source_cn: 光是一杯酒的价值好像还不足以回报你的恩情，还有什么我能为你做到的事吗？
choice_prompt:17:1460604015.male: Still, one drink doesn't feel like enough to repay your kindness. Is there anything else I can do for you?
choice_prompt:17:1460604015.female: Still, one drink doesn't feel like enough to repay your kindness. Is there anything else I can do for you?

say:19:1460604017:1.text: Pandora takes out the blue seashell and looks it over in her hands.
say:19:1460604017:1.source_cn: 潘多拉拿出了那枚蓝色的海螺，捧在手中端详。
say:19:1460604017:1.male: Pandora takes out the blue seashell and looks it over in her hands.
say:19:1460604017:1.female: Pandora takes out the blue seashell and looks it over in her hands.

say:20:1460604018:0.text: To be honest, I think this seashell is a lot like the box I carry with me.
say:20:1460604018:0.source_cn: 其实我觉得，这枚海螺，或许和我身上的匣子很像呢。
say:20:1460604018:0.male: To be honest, I think this seashell is a lot like the box I carry with me.
say:20:1460604018:0.female: To be honest, I think this seashell is a lot like the box I carry with me.

say:21:1460604019:1.text: It looks beautiful from afar. But if you touch it, you might bring misfortune upon yourself.
say:21:1460604019:1.source_cn: 远看美好，但接触之后，便会为自身招致不幸。
say:21:1460604019:1.male: It looks beautiful from afar. But if you touch it, you might bring misfortune upon yourself.
say:21:1460604019:1.female: It looks beautiful from afar. But if you touch it, you might bring misfortune upon yourself.

say:22:1460604020:0.text: As a gift, it's all wrong... It's the worst kind of gift.
say:22:1460604020:0.source_cn: 作为礼物，这是……绝对不合格的。这是最差劲的礼物。
say:22:1460604020:0.male: As a gift, it's all wrong... It's the worst kind of gift.
say:22:1460604020:0.female: As a gift, it's all wrong... It's the worst kind of gift.

choice_prompt:23:1460604020.text: As a gift, it's all wrong... It's the worst kind of gift.
choice_prompt:23:1460604020.source_cn: 作为礼物，这是……绝对不合格的。这是最差劲的礼物。
choice_prompt:23:1460604020.male: As a gift, it's all wrong... It's the worst kind of gift.
choice_prompt:23:1460604020.female: As a gift, it's all wrong... It's the worst kind of gift.

say:26:1460604023:1.text: Even if it was dangerous or ominous... even if its beauty only serves to take lives...
say:26:1460604023:1.source_cn: 即使是有毒的、不祥的……即使它的美丽只是夺取人命的帮凶……
say:26:1460604023:1.male: Even if it was dangerous or ominous... even if its beauty only serves to take lives...
say:26:1460604023:1.female: Even if it was dangerous or ominous... even if its beauty only serves to take lives...

say:27:1460604024:1.text: You'd still take it? You'd still accept something like that?
say:27:1460604024:1.source_cn: 即使是这样的东西，你也愿意收下吗？也可以被你收下吗？
say:27:1460604024:1.male: You'd still take it? You'd still accept something like that?
say:27:1460604024:1.female: You'd still take it? You'd still accept something like that?

say:28:1460604025:1.text: Strands of hair hang down over Pandora's face, glinting with a dim light.
say:28:1460604025:1.source_cn: 垂下的发丝略略遮住了潘多拉的脸庞，闪动着黯淡的光芒。
say:28:1460604025:1.male: Strands of hair hang down over Pandora's face, glinting with a dim light.
say:28:1460604025:1.female: Strands of hair hang down over Pandora's face, glinting with a dim light.

say:29:1460604026:1.source_cn: 毋庸置疑的美丽，毋庸置疑的珍贵。

say:30:1460604027:1.text: Whatever danger once lay hidden in that blue seashell is long gone. What shines before you now is a true and sincere heart.
say:30:1460604027:1.source_cn: 蓝色的螺壳之中曾经蕴含着怎样的危险已不可考，但现在在你...
say:30:1460604027:1.male: Whatever danger once lay hidden in that blue seashell is long gone. What shines before you now is a true and sincere heart.
say:30:1460604027:1.female: Whatever danger once lay hidden in that blue seashell is long gone. What shines before you now is a true and sincere heart.

say:32:1460604029:1.text: Am I really allowed to stay?
say:32:1460604029:1.male: Am I really allowed to stay?
say:32:1460604029:1.female: Am I really allowed to stay?

choice_prompt:33:1460604029.text: Am I really allowed to stay?
choice_prompt:33:1460604029.male: Am I really allowed to stay?
choice_prompt:33:1460604029.female: Am I really allowed to stay?

say:34:1460604030:1.text: I... I don't even know what to say.
say:34:1460604030:1.male: I... I don't even know what to say.
say:34:1460604030:1.female: I... I don't even know what to say.

say:35:1460604032:1.text: Pandora falls silent for a moment. Not wanting the mood to grow heavy, you gently take the seashell from her hand.
say:35:1460604032:1.source_cn: 潘多拉一时不再言语，你不想让气氛凝滞，取走了她手中的海螺。
say:35:1460604032:1.male: Pandora falls silent for a moment. Not wanting the mood to grow heavy, you gently take the seashell from her hand.
say:35:1460604032:1.female: Pandora falls silent for a moment. Not wanting the mood to grow heavy, you gently take the seashell from her hand.

say:36:1460604033:1.text: She looks surprised for a moment, then chuckles.
say:36:1460604033:1.source_cn: 她愣了一下，随后笑了出来。
say:36:1460604033:1.male: She looks surprised for a moment, then chuckles.
say:36:1460604033:1.female: She looks surprised for a moment, then chuckles.

say:37:1460604034:1.text: Didn't expect you to be so forward, Magister.
say:37:1460604034:1.source_cn: 没想到大魔法师也会有这么不客气的时候。
say:37:1460604034:1.male: Didn't expect you to be so forward, Magister.
say:37:1460604034:1.female: Didn't expect you to be so forward, Magister.

say:38:1460604035:1.text: In that case, I'll be a little forward too. I have a request.
say:38:1460604035:1.source_cn: 那么，我也不客气了，我有个请求。
say:38:1460604035:1.male: In that case, I'll be a little forward too. I have a request.
say:38:1460604035:1.female: In that case, I'll be a little forward too. I have a request.

choice_prompt:39:1460604035.text: In that case, I'll be a little forward too. I have a request.
choice_prompt:39:1460604035.source_cn: 那么，我也不客气了，我有个请求。
choice_prompt:39:1460604035.male: In that case, I'll be a little forward too. I have a request.
choice_prompt:39:1460604035.female: In that case, I'll be a little forward too. I have a request.

say:40:1460604036:1.text: Can I... call you Merlin, like the others do?
say:40:1460604036:1.source_cn: 我……能像其他人一样，叫你梅林吗？
say:40:1460604036:1.male: Can I... call you Merlin, like the others do?
say:40:1460604036:1.female: Can I... call you Merlin, like the others do?

say:41:1460604037:1.text: Don't worry, it's not a spell or anything. It's just that... I've made a few friends here.
say:41:1460604037:1.source_cn: 别怕！这不是诅咒什么的，只是，我在这里也有了一些朋友。
say:41:1460604037:1.male: Don't worry, it's not a spell or anything. It's just that... I've made a few friends here.
say:41:1460604037:1.female: Don't worry, it's not a spell or anything. It's just that... I've made a few friends here.

say:42:1460604038:1.text: I want to be able to say your name when I talk with them.
say:42:1460604038:1.source_cn: 我希望在和她们聊天的时候，能够提起你的名字。
say:42:1460604038:1.male: I want to be able to say your name when I talk with them.
say:42:1460604038:1.female: I want to be able to say your name when I talk with them.

say:43:1460604039:1.text: Like, "Merlin is my friend", "Merlin is my host", or "Merlin is someone I trust"...
say:43:1460604039:1.source_cn: 比如，梅林是我的朋友，是我的东道主，是我信赖的人……
say:43:1460604039:1.male: Like, "Merlin is my friend", "Merlin is my host", or "Merlin is someone I trust"...
say:43:1460604039:1.female: Like, "Merlin is my friend", "Merlin is my host", or "Merlin is someone I trust"...

narration:46:1460604041:0.text: The night stretches on. You end up talking about many things.
narration:46:1460604041:0.source_cn: 这一夜很长，你们后来又说了许多关于彼此的事情
narration:46:1460604041:0.male: The night stretches on. You end up talking about many things.
narration:46:1460604041:0.female: The night stretches on. You end up talking about many things.

narration:48:1460604042:0.text: The blue seashell finds its place on the windowsill, where the wind can reach it.
narration:48:1460604042:0.source_cn: 那枚蓝色的海螺，被放在一个有风吹过的窗口
narration:48:1460604042:0.male: The blue seashell finds its place on the windowsill, where the wind can reach it.
narration:48:1460604042:0.female: The blue seashell finds its place on the windowsill, where the wind can reach it.

narration:49:1460604043:0.text: And later that night, you both hear it sing whenever a breeze blows by.
narration:49:1460604043:0.source_cn: 那晚，你们的耳朵一同发现，它会在有风吹来时发出吟唱般的声音
narration:49:1460604043:0.male: And later that night, you both hear it sing whenever a breeze blows by.
narration:49:1460604043:0.female: And later that night, you both hear it sing whenever a breeze blows by.

choice:33:1:2.source_cn: 你已经是神秘屋的一员了

choice:17:0:1.text: Can I see the earlier gift?
choice:17:0:1.male: Can I see the earlier gift?
choice:17:0:1.female: Can I see the earlier gift?

choice:17:1:2.text: Tell me more about your past.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 想知道潘多拉之前的事
choice:17:1:2.male: Tell me more about your past.
choice:17:1:2.female: Tell me more about your past.

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 他应该不会做赔本生意

say:52:1460604005:1.text: Maybe. Where I come from, this kind of coin isn't worth much.
say:52:1460604005:1.source_cn: 或许吧？这金币在我的家乡的确不算什么珍宝。
say:52:1460604005:1.male: Maybe. Where I come from, this kind of coin isn't worth much.
say:52:1460604005:1.female: Maybe. Where I come from, this kind of coin isn't worth much.
